description: Generate random UK Set For Life lines. Each line has 5 main numbers from 1 to 47 (unique, sorted low to high) plus one Life Ball from 1 to 10, drawn with cryptographic randomness. Draws are Monday and Thursday; the top prize is £10,000 a month for 30 years at odds of 1 in 15,339,390. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/set-for-life-generator/

lines.description: How many lines to generate, 1 to 10 (default 1)
